questionText: Who was sworn in as the 14th President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan in March 2024, becoming the only civilian to hold the office twice?
explanation: Asif Ali Zardari was sworn in as Pakistan's 14th President on March 10, 2024, after securing 411 electoral college votes, having previously served from 2008 to 2013.

questionText: Following the February 2024 general elections, who was elected as the 24th Prime Minister of Pakistan?
explanation: Mian Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif was elected as the 24th Prime Minister of Pakistan on March 3, 2024, securing 201 votes in the National Assembly.

questionText: Who was elected as the first-ever female Chief Minister of any province in the history of Pakistan in February 2024?
explanation: Maryam Nawaz Sharif was elected as the first female Chief Minister of Punjab on February 26, 2024, securing 220 votes in the Punjab Assembly.

questionText: Who was elected as the Chief Minister of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa following the February 2024 general elections?
explanation: Ali Amin Gandapur was elected as the Chief Minister of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on March 1, 2024, with 90 votes.

questionText: Who assumed office as the Chief Minister of Sindh for a historic third consecutive term in February 2024?
explanation: Syed Murad Ali Shah was elected Chief Minister of Sindh on February 26, 2024, marking his third term as Chief Minister.

questionText: Who was elected as the Chief Minister of Balochistan in March 2024 unopposed?
explanation: Mir Sarfraz Bugti was elected Chief Minister of Balochistan unopposed on March 2, 2024.

questionText: Who was elected as the Speaker of the 16th National Assembly of Pakistan in March 2024?
explanation: Sardar Ayaz Sadiq was elected Speaker of the National Assembly for a third non-consecutive tenure on March 1, 2024.

questionText: Who was elected unopposed as the Chairman of the Senate of Pakistan in April 2024?
explanation: Former Prime Minister Syed Yousaf Raza Gillani was elected Chairman of the Senate unopposed on April 9, 2024.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Deputy Prime Minister of Pakistan in April 2024 in addition to his portfolio as Foreign Minister?
explanation: Foreign Minister Senator Ishaq Dar was formally designated as the Deputy Prime Minister of Pakistan on April 28, 2024.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue in the Shehbaz Sharif cabinet in March 2024?
explanation: Former HBL President & CEO Muhammad Aurangzeb was appointed Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue to spearhead economic and IMF reforms.

questionText: In October 2024, the Parliament of Pakistan enacted the landmark 26th Constitutional Amendment. What key change did it introduce regarding the appointment of the Chief Justice of Pakistan?

options.A: The CJP is selected by a 12-member Special Parliamentary Committee from a panel of the three senior-most Supreme Court judges
options.B: The CJP is appointed directly by the Prime Minister without parliamentary input
options.C: The CJP is elected by secret ballot of all bar associations
options.D: The senior-most judge automatically becomes CJP without exception

correctAnswerText: The CJP is selected by a 12-member Special Parliamentary Committee from a panel of the three senior-most Supreme Court judges
explanation: The 26th Amendment amended Article 175A so that the CJP is nominated by a cross-party 12-member Special Parliamentary Committee from among the three senior-most Supreme Court judges.

questionText: What fixed tenure of office was established for the Chief Justice of Pakistan under the 26th Constitutional Amendment, 2024?

options.A: 3 years (or until attaining retirement age of 65)

correctAnswerText: 3 years (or until attaining retirement age of 65)
explanation: The 26th Amendment introduced a fixed tenure of three (3) years for the Chief Justice of Pakistan, subject to the maximum retirement age of 65 years.

questionText: Who was appointed as the 30th Chief Justice of Pakistan in October 2024, becoming the first CJP appointed under the 26th Constitutional Amendment?
explanation: Justice Yahya Afridi took oath as the 30th Chief Justice of Pakistan on October 26, 2024, succeeding Justice Qazi Faez Isa.

questionText: The 26th Constitutional Amendment mandated the creation of which specialized benches within the Supreme Court and High Courts?
explanation: The amendment established dedicated Constitutional Benches in the Supreme Court (under Article 191A) and High Courts to exclusively hear constitutional matters and original writ petitions.

questionText: Who was nominated as the first head of the Constitutional Bench of the Supreme Court of Pakistan in November 2024?
explanation: The Judicial Commission of Pakistan nominated Justice Amin-ud-Din Khan to head the first 7-member Constitutional Bench of the Supreme Court.

questionText: Which retired judge made history by taking oath as the first female judge of the Supreme Court of Pakistan and continues serving on landmark constitutional benches?
explanation: Justice Ayesha A. Malik became the first female Supreme Court Justice of Pakistan in January 2022 and plays a leading role in the senior judiciary.

questionText: In November 2024, the Parliament of Pakistan passed legislation increasing the sanctioned number of Supreme Court judges from 17 to:
explanation: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) (Amendment) Act, 2024 increased the sanctioned strength of Supreme Court judges up to 34 to address the massive backlog and staff constitutional benches.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Chief Justice of the Islamabad High Court (IHC) in 2024?
explanation: Justice Aamer Farooq serves as the Chief Justice of the Islamabad High Court.

questionText: In November 2024, Parliament passed amendments extending the statutory tenure of the three Armed Forces Service Chiefs (COAS, CNS, CAS) from 3 years to:
explanation: The Pakistan Army, Navy, and Air Force Amendment Bills 2024 increased the fixed tenure of all three service chiefs from three to five years.

questionText: Who currently serves as the Chief of Army Staff (COAS) of Pakistan, holding the rank of General since November 2022?
explanation: General Syed Asim Munir, NI (M), took charge as Pakistan's 11th Chief of Army Staff on November 29, 2022.

questionText: Which major international summit did Pakistan successfully host in Islamabad on October 15–16, 2024?
explanation: Pakistan hosted the 23rd Council of Heads of Government of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) in Islamabad, chaired by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.

questionText: Which Chinese Premier visited Pakistan in October 2024 on an official bilateral visit ahead of the SCO Summit, the first Chinese Premier visit in 11 years?
explanation: Premier of the State Council of China Li Qiang undertook a historic four-day bilateral visit to Pakistan from October 14–17, 2024.

questionText: During Premier Li Qiang's visit in October 2024, which state-of-the-art CPEC infrastructure mega-project was virtually inaugurated in Balochistan?
explanation: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chinese Premier Li Qiang jointly inaugurated the newly constructed, grant-funded New Gwadar International Airport (NGIA).

questionText: Which Indian External Affairs Minister attended the SCO Summit in Islamabad in October 2024, marking the first visit by an Indian Foreign Minister to Pakistan in nine years?
explanation: Dr. S. Jaishankar visited Islamabad on October 15–16, 2024 to participate in the SCO Heads of Government meeting, the first such visit since 2015.

questionText: In June 2024, Pakistan was overwhelmingly elected as a non-permanent member of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) for which two-year term?
explanation: Pakistan won a non-permanent seat on the UN Security Council for the 2025–2026 term, securing 182 votes out of 193 in the UN General Assembly (Pakistan's 8th term on the UNSC).

questionText: Who is the current Permanent Representative of Pakistan to the United Nations in New York, who led Pakistan's successful UNSC campaign?
explanation: Veteran diplomat Ambassador Munir Akram serves as Pakistan's Permanent Representative to the United Nations.

questionText: In October 2024, a high-level official Saudi business and ministerial delegation visited Islamabad, signing how many memorandums of understanding (MoUs) worth $2.8 billion?
explanation: The Saudi delegation led by Investment Minister Khalid Al-Falih signed 27 MoUs and agreements worth $2.8 billion spanning energy, mining, agriculture, and IT.

questionText: What is the primary objective of CPEC Phase-II launched jointly by Pakistan and China in 2024?

options.A: Focusing on industrial cooperation, business-to-business (B2B) investments, agriculture, IT, and Special Economic Zones (SEZs)
options.B: Building railway lines only in Xinjiang
options.C: Replacing coal plants with nuclear plants exclusively
options.D: Constructing residential apartments only in Beijing

correctAnswerText: Focusing on industrial cooperation, business-to-business (B2B) investments, agriculture, IT, and Special Economic Zones (SEZs)
explanation: CPEC Phase-II pivots from government-to-government infrastructure to B2B partnerships, industrialization, modern agriculture, IT corridors, and green development.

questionText: In May 2024, which Iranian President visited Pakistan on an official three-day state visit before his tragic demise in a helicopter crash shortly afterward?
explanation: Iranian President Dr. Seyed Ebrahim Raisi visited Islamabad, Lahore, and Karachi from April 22–24, 2024, before tragically perishing in a helicopter crash in May 2024.

questionText: Who was appointed as Pakistan's Ambassador to the United States in 2024?
explanation: Career diplomat Rizwan Saeed Sheikh assumed duties as Pakistan's Ambassador to the United States in Washington in August 2024, succeeding Masood Khan.

questionText: At the COP29 Climate Summit in Baku (November 2024), Pakistan actively campaigned for:

options.A: Operationalization and capitalization of the Loss and Damage Fund for climate-vulnerable countries
options.B: The abolition of green energy subsidies

correctAnswerText: Operationalization and capitalization of the Loss and Damage Fund for climate-vulnerable countries
explanation: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and climate officials emphasized urgent grant-based climate financing and swift activation of the Loss and Damage Fund.

questionText: Which international regional organization granted Pakistan the chairmanship of its Council of Heads of Government for the 2023–2024 tenure?
explanation: Pakistan held the rotating chairmanship of the SCO Council of Heads of Government (CHG), concluding with the Islamabad Summit in October 2024.

questionText: Which Central Asian President visited Pakistan in July 2024 to sign a Strategic Partnership Agreement and enhance transit trade through Pakistani seaports?
explanation: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev and high-level delegations engaged Pakistan on the Trans-Afghan Railway and bilateral transit agreements.

questionText: Pakistan has formally applied to join which expanding global South economic grouping whose 16th summit was held in Kazan, Russia in October 2024?
explanation: Pakistan submitted a formal application to join BRICS, seeking membership in the expanding emerging economies bloc.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Director General of the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) in 2022 and continues as chief military spokesman?
explanation: Lt Gen Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry serves as the Director General of ISPR.

questionText: In September 2024, the Executive Board of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) approved a new financial bailout program for Pakistan worth:

options.A: $7 Billion under a 37-month Extended Fund Facility (EFF)

correctAnswerText: $7 Billion under a 37-month Extended Fund Facility (EFF)
explanation: The IMF approved a 37-month, SDR 5.32 billion ($7 billion) Extended Fund Facility (EFF) for Pakistan to restore economic stability and fiscal discipline.

questionText: What is the primary role of the Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC) established in Pakistan?

options.A: Acting as a 'single-window' hybrid civil-military platform to fast-track foreign direct investments in agriculture, IT, mining, and energy

correctAnswerText: Acting as a 'single-window' hybrid civil-military platform to fast-track foreign direct investments in agriculture, IT, mining, and energy
explanation: SIFC serves as an apex single-window facilitator to remove bureaucratic hurdles and attract foreign investment from GCC countries and international partners.

questionText: In the mega-mining sector, which world-class copper and gold project in Balochistan's Chagai district is being developed by Barrick Gold under SIFC facilitation?
explanation: The Reko Diq mine is one of the world's largest undeveloped copper-gold porphyry deposits, jointly developed by Barrick Gold (50%) and Pakistani state/provincial entities.

questionText: In the second half of 2024, the State Bank of Pakistan's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) reduced the Policy Interest Rate significantly from its historic peak of:
explanation: Following steep disinflation, the SBP slashed its policy rate from an all-time high of 22% in June 2024 down to 15% by November 2024, and continued easing.

questionText: Who serves as the Governor of the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP), appointed for a five-year term in August 2022?
explanation: Jameel Ahmad was appointed Governor of the State Bank of Pakistan on August 19, 2022.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Chairman of the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) in August 2024 to oversee tax digitisation and transformation?
explanation: Senior civil servant Rashid Mahmood Langrial assumed charge as Chairman FBR on August 7, 2024.

questionText: What digital initiative did FBR launch in 2024 to track retail sales in real-time and broaden the tax base?

options.A: Tajir Dost Scheme and nationwide Point of Sale (POS) integration

correctAnswerText: Tajir Dost Scheme and nationwide Point of Sale (POS) integration
explanation: The Tajir Dost Scheme was launched in 2024 to register retailers and wholesale traders into the formal tax net.

questionText: In late 2024, the government attempted the privatization bidding of which national loss-making state-owned enterprise (SOE)?
explanation: The privatization auction of PIA was conducted in October 2024 as part of state-owned enterprise restructuring under the IMF program.

questionText: Which credit rating agencies upgraded Pakistan's sovereign credit ratings in mid-2024 citing improving macroeconomic stability and IMF program approval?

options.A: Fitch Ratings (to CCC+) and Moody's (to Caa2)

correctAnswerText: Fitch Ratings (to CCC+) and Moody's (to Caa2)
explanation: Fitch upgraded Pakistan to 'CCC+' in July 2024, and Moody's upgraded the rating to 'Caa2' in August 2024 with a positive outlook.

questionText: What was the headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation trajectory in Pakistan during late 2024 compared to 38% in mid-2023?
explanation: Pakistan achieved dramatic disinflation, with headline CPI dropping into single digits (6.9% in Sept 2024 and 7.2% in Oct 2024) from peak levels of 38%.

questionText: The total circular debt in Pakistan's power sector in 2024 hovered around which massive figure, prompting structural reforms and tariff adjustments?

options.A: Approximately Rs. 2.4 Trillion to Rs. 2.6 Trillion

correctAnswerText: Approximately Rs. 2.4 Trillion to Rs. 2.6 Trillion
explanation: Power sector circular debt reached roughly Rs. 2.6 trillion, necessitating renegotiation of contracts with Independent Power Producers (IPPs).

questionText: In 2024, the federal government successfully renegotiated power purchase agreements with several early-generation IPPs to:

options.A: Terminate take-or-pay capacity payments and transition to take-and-pay mode, saving billions
options.D: Sell power grids to foreign consumers

correctAnswerText: Terminate take-or-pay capacity payments and transition to take-and-pay mode, saving billions
explanation: Task forces renegotiated contracts with IPPs to eliminate capacity charges, yielding estimated savings of over Rs. 400 billion.

questionText: Which country continues to be the largest source of worker remittances sent home by expatriate Pakistanis, exceeding $7 billion annually?
explanation: Saudi Arabia remains the largest source of foreign remittances for Pakistan, followed by the UAE, UK, and USA.

questionText: Pakistan's IT and telecommunications service export remittances reached a record high in the fiscal year 2023–2024, surpassing:
explanation: Pakistan's IT exports hit an all-time record of $3.22 billion in FY 2023–24, registering a 24% year-on-year growth.

questionText: What is the name of the central gas pipeline project designed to transport natural gas from Turkmenistan through Afghanistan and Pakistan to India?
explanation: The Turkmenistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan-India (TAPI) natural gas pipeline project held high-level implementation meetings in 2024.

questionText: The CASA-1000 regional electricity transmission project connects Pakistan to surplus hydroelectric power generated in which two Central Asian nations?
explanation: CASA-1000 enables the transfer of 1,300 MW of summer hydropower from Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan to Afghanistan and Pakistan.

questionText: What was the total outlay of the Federal Budget of Pakistan for the fiscal year 2024–2025 presented by Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb?
explanation: The Federal Budget 2024–25 had an unprecedented total outlay of Rs. 18.877 trillion with a tax revenue target of Rs. 12.97 trillion.

questionText: What is the single largest expenditure head in the Federal Budget 2024–2025, consuming over Rs. 9.7 Trillion?
explanation: Markup/interest payments on domestic and external public debt absorbed Rs. 9.775 trillion, constituting over 51% of total federal budget outlay.

questionText: In 2024, the Government of Pakistan initiated negotiations to issue sovereign 'Panda Bonds' denominated in which currency?
explanation: Pakistan advanced preparations to tap China's domestic bond market by issuing Panda Bonds in Chinese Yuan to diversify financing sources.

questionText: Which deep-water seaport in Pakistan saw its first shipment of transit trade containers to Uzbekistan and Central Asian republics in 2024?
explanation: Gwadar Port handled key shipments of trade goods, fertilizers, and transit cargo to Central Asia, expanding commercial traffic.

questionText: On May 3, 2024, Pakistan achieved a historic space milestone by launching its first-ever lunar satellite mission named:
explanation: Pakistan's miniature lunar orbiter ICUBE-Qamar was successfully launched aboard China's Chang'e 6 lunar exploration mission from Hainan, China.

questionText: Which Pakistani institute developed the ICube-Qamar satellite in collaboration with SUPARCO and Shanghai Jiao Tong University?
explanation: ICUBE-Qamar was designed and developed by students and researchers at the Institute of Space Technology (IST) in Islamabad.

questionText: On May 30, 2024, Pakistan launched its advanced multi-mission communication satellite from the Xichang Satellite Launch Centre. What is it named?
explanation: PakSat-MM1 (Multi-Mission Satellite 1) was launched to provide high-speed broadband internet and broadcasting coverage across Pakistan and the region.

questionText: Who is the national space agency of Pakistan responsible for space research and satellite launches?

options.A: SUPARCO (Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission)

correctAnswerText: SUPARCO (Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission)
explanation: SUPARCO is Pakistan's national space executive and scientific research body, established in 1961.

questionText: In June 2024, the Federal Cabinet approved a comprehensive national counter-terrorism campaign under the revised National Action Plan titled:
explanation: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and the apex committee approved Operation Azm-e-Istehkam to eliminate extremism and terrorism across Pakistan.

questionText: In 2024, Pakistan's armed forces inducted a modern fleet of fifth-generation stealth fighter jets into service. Which fighter model did Pakistan announce it was acquiring from China?
explanation: Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Baber Sidhu confirmed that the Pakistan Air Force (PAF) is acquiring Chinese fifth-generation FC-31 / J-31 stealth fighters.

questionText: Who currently serves as the Chief of the Naval Staff of the Pakistan Navy, having assumed office in October 2023?
explanation: Admiral Naveed Ashraf, NI(M), serves as the 23rd Chief of the Naval Staff of the Pakistan Navy.

questionText: Who currently serves as the Chief of the Air Staff of the Pakistan Air Force (PAF)?

options.A: Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Baber Sidhu
options.B: Air Chief Marshal Mujahid Anwar Khan
options.D: Air Chief Marshal Tahir Rafique Butt

correctAnswerText: Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Baber Sidhu
explanation: Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Baber Sidhu has served as the CAS since March 2021.

questionText: What is the name of the newly commissioned Hangor-class stealth submarines being constructed jointly by Pakistan and China for the Pakistan Navy?
explanation: The first Hangor-class diesel-electric submarine equipped with Air-Independent Propulsion (AIP) was launched in Wuhan, China in April 2024.

questionText: In 2024, the Pakistan Army successfully conducted training launches of which guided multi-launch rocket system (MLRS) having a range of 400 km?
explanation: Pakistan conducted successful flight tests of the indigenously developed guided rocket system Fatah-II with a strike range of 400 km.

questionText: In October 2024, which international defense exhibition and seminar was held at the Karachi Expo Centre, featuring global defense manufacturers?

options.A: IDEAS 2024 (12th International Defence Exhibition and Seminar)

correctAnswerText: IDEAS 2024 (12th International Defence Exhibition and Seminar)
explanation: IDEAS 2024 was held in Karachi from November 19–22, 2024, showcasing Pakistan's defense production capabilities.

questionText: Who serves as the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee (CJCSC) of Pakistan?
explanation: General Sahir Shamshad Mirza, NI (M), serves as the Chairman Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee.

questionText: In 2024, Pakistan hosted the 7th International Pakistan Army Team Spirit (PATS) competition at Kharian, featuring teams from how many friendly countries?
explanation: PATS-2024 witnessed military teams from friendly nations including the US, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Jordan, and others.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Chairman of the National Accountability Bureau (NAB) in March 2023 for a three-year statutory term?
explanation: Lt. Gen. (retd) Nazir Ahmad Butt was appointed Chairman NAB on March 4, 2023.

questionText: Who serves as the Director General of the Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) in 2024?
explanation: Senior police officer Ahmad Ishaque Jehangir was appointed Director General FIA in January 2024.

questionText: At the 2024 Paris Olympic Games, Pakistani athlete Arshad Nadeem won the Gold Medal in Men's Javelin Throw, setting a historic Olympic record with a throw of:
explanation: Arshad Nadeem shattered the 16-year Olympic record with a monumental throw of 92.97 meters on August 8, 2024, winning Pakistan's first Olympic gold in 40 years.

questionText: When did Pakistan last win an Olympic medal of any color before Arshad Nadeem's gold in Paris 2024?
explanation: Arshad Nadeem ended Pakistan's 32-year Olympic medal drought; Pakistan's previous medal was a bronze in men's hockey at Barcelona in 1992.

questionText: What civil award did the President of Pakistan confer upon Olympic Champion Arshad Nadeem in recognition of his historic Paris 2024 victory?
explanation: President Asif Ali Zardari conferred Pakistan's second-highest civilian honor, the Hilal-e-Imtiaz, upon Arshad Nadeem on Independence Day 2024.

questionText: Which country is scheduled to host the ICC Men's Champions Trophy in February–March 2025 across venues in Karachi, Lahore, and Rawalpindi?
explanation: Pakistan is the official host of the ICC Men's Champions Trophy 2025, marking the return of an ICC tournament to Pakistan after nearly three decades.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Chairman of the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) in February 2024 and subsequently also became Federal Interior Minister?
explanation: Syed Mohsin Raza Naqvi was elected unanimously as the 37th Chairman of the PCB on February 6, 2024, and later took oath as Federal Minister for Interior.

questionText: In November 2024, the Pakistan National Cricket Team recorded a historic bilateral ODI series victory in Australia after how many years?

options.A: 22 years (first ODI series win in Australia since 2002)

correctAnswerText: 22 years (first ODI series win in Australia since 2002)
explanation: Under captain Mohammad Rizwan, Pakistan defeated Australia 2-1 in the ODI series in November 2024, their first ODI series victory on Australian soil in 22 years.

questionText: Who was appointed as Pakistan's white-ball cricket captain (ODI & T20I) in October 2024, succeeding Babar Azam?
explanation: Wicketkeeper-batsman Mohammad Rizwan was named white-ball captain of Pakistan on October 27, 2024.

questionText: Who serves as the captain of the Pakistan Test Cricket Team as of late 2024?
explanation: Shan Masood leads the Pakistan Test cricket team, captaining the historic 2-1 series triumph over England in October 2024.

questionText: In snooker, which Pakistani cueist won the IBSF World Snooker Championship title in Doha, Qatar in November 2024?
explanation: Veteran Pakistani cueist Muhammad Asif won his third IBSF World Snooker Championship title in Doha in November 2024, beating Iran's Ali Gharahgozlou.

questionText: Which Pakistani female mountaineer became the youngest Pakistani woman to summit Mount Everest and K2 in 2023–2024?
explanation: Naila Kiani has successfully summited 10 of the world's 14 eight-thousander peaks, receiving the Sitara-e-Imtiaz.

questionText: Who is the youngest mountaineer in the world to summit all 14 peaks above 8,000 meters, completing the feat in October 2024 at age 22?
explanation: Pakistani mountaineer Shehroze Kashif successfully summited Shishapangma in October 2024, becoming the youngest person in history to summit all 14 eight-thousanders.

questionText: Which team won the 9th edition of the Pakistan Super League (PSL 9) held in March 2024, claiming their third PSL trophy?
explanation: Islamabad United, captained by Shadab Khan, defeated Multan Sultans in a thrilling last-ball final in Karachi to win PSL 9.

questionText: Who was appointed as the head coach of Pakistan's men's red-ball (Test) cricket team in early 2024?
explanation: Former Australian fast bowler Jason Gillespie was appointed head coach of Pakistan's Test cricket team.

questionText: Which Pakistani squash player won the World Junior Squash Championship title in Melbourne, Australia in 2023 and retained senior international ranking in 2024?
explanation: Hamza Khan won the World Junior Squash Championship, becoming the first Pakistani to win the title since Jansher Khan in 1986.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Chairman of the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan?
explanation: Dr. Mukhtar Ahmed serves as the Chairman of the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan.

questionText: What was the official slogan/theme for Pakistan Day celebrated on 23rd March 2024?

options.A: 'Pohanchain Gay Manzil Par' (We shall reach our destination)

correctAnswerText: 'Pohanchain Gay Manzil Par' (We shall reach our destination)
explanation: The theme for Pakistan Day 2024 was 'Pohanchain Gay Manzil Par', highlighting national resilience and economic revival.

questionText: In late 2024, which province in Pakistan declared a health and environmental emergency due to hazardous smog and air pollution exceeding AQI 1000?
explanation: Punjab experienced record toxic smog in October–November 2024, prompting closure of schools and artificial rain trials in Lahore.

questionText: Which international financial institution approved a $1 billion funding package in 2024 for the Dasu Hydropower Stage-I Project in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa?
explanation: The World Bank approved additional financing for the 4,320 MW Dasu Hydropower Project on the Indus River.

questionText: Which Chinese-built nuclear power plant unit in Karachi, K-3, completed its commercial operational warranty in 2023–2024, contributing 1,100 MW of clean base-load electricity?
explanation: Karachi Nuclear Power Plant Unit 3 (K-3) operates with the Chinese Hualong One reactor design, generating 1,100 MW of power.

questionText: In 2024, Pakistan and China signed a commercial agreement to begin construction of which 1,200 MW nuclear power project in Mianwali?
explanation: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif broke ground for the 1,200 MW Chashma Nuclear Power Plant Unit 5 (C-5), developed with CNNC.

questionText: The Gwadar Smart Port City Master Plan is supported under the bilateral vision of CPEC. What is the designated special status of Gwadar Free Zone?

options.A: 23-year tax holiday for investors and businesses established in the Free Zone
options.D: State ownership of all private assets

correctAnswerText: 23-year tax holiday for investors and businesses established in the Free Zone
explanation: The Gwadar Free Zone offers a 23-year exemption from corporate income tax, customs duties, and federal sales taxes to incentivize export manufacturing.

questionText: Who took oath as the 29th Chief Justice of Pakistan in September 2023 and retired on October 25, 2024?
explanation: Justice Qazi Faez Isa served as the 29th CJP from September 17, 2023 to October 25, 2024.

questionText: The Pakistan Digital City (Special Technology Zone) project in Haripur is located in which province?
explanation: The Pakistan Digital City is KP's flagship Special Technology Zone (STZ) established in Haripur near Islamabad.

questionText: The National Cyber Security Policy of Pakistan is executed under the supervision of which federal authority established under PECA?

options.A: National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) / FIA Cybercrime Wing

correctAnswerText: National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) / FIA Cybercrime Wing
explanation: The federal government notified the creation of the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) to handle digital forensics and cyber offenses.

questionText: In 2024, Pakistan's Ministry of Information Technology introduced 5G spectrum auction roadmaps. Which regulatory body is responsible for conducting the spectrum auction?
explanation: PTA in coordination with the Frequency Allocation Board (FAB) is mandated to auction 5G telecommunication spectrum licenses.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) of Pakistan, who oversaw the 2024 General Elections?
explanation: Sikandar Sultan Raja serves as the Chief Election Commissioner of the Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP).

questionText: What is the name of the nationwide digitized census results officially notified by the Council of Common Interests (CCI) in August 2023, recording Pakistan's population at 241.49 Million?

options.A: 7th Population and Housing Census (1st Digital Census of Pakistan)

correctAnswerText: 7th Population and Housing Census (1st Digital Census of Pakistan)
explanation: Pakistan's first-ever digital census conducted by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS) officially recorded a population of 241.49 million with a 2.55% annual growth rate.

questionText: Which Pakistani documentary film on climate change and environmental justice was showcased at international film festivals in 2024?

options.A: 'In Search of Green' / Climate resilience series by Pakistani filmmakers

correctAnswerText: 'In Search of Green' / Climate resilience series by Pakistani filmmakers
explanation: Pakistani environmental documentaries gained worldwide acclaim in the wake of the 2022 super floods and ongoing climate crisis.

questionText: Who was awarded the prestigious Nobel Peace Prize nomination from Pakistan's civil rights sector in 2024?

options.A: Prominent human rights and flood relief community organizers

correctAnswerText: Prominent human rights and flood relief community organizers
explanation: Pakistani grassroots climate activists and flood volunteers were widely recognized for community disaster resilience.

questionText: In 2024, which province in Pakistan launched the 'Kisan Card' offering interest-free agricultural loans up to Rs. 150,000 per farmer for seeds and fertilizers?
explanation: Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz launched the 'CM Punjab Kisan Card' program with an initial allocation of Rs. 400 billion to support farmers.

questionText: Who won the 2024 United States Presidential Election held on November 5, 2024, to become the 47th President of the United States?
explanation: Donald Trump won the 2024 presidential election securing over 312 electoral votes, becoming the second president in US history to serve two non-consecutive terms.

questionText: Who was elected as the 50th Vice President of the United States alongside Donald Trump in the 2024 election?
explanation: Ohio Senator JD Vance was elected as the Vice President of the United States in the November 2024 election.

questionText: In July 2024, which political leader led the Labour Party to a landslide victory, ending 14 years of Conservative rule to become the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom?
explanation: Sir Keir Starmer became Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on July 5, 2024, after Labour won 411 parliamentary seats.

questionText: Who was sworn in for a historic third consecutive term as the Prime Minister of India in June 2024?
explanation: Narendra Modi took oath for a third consecutive term as Prime Minister of India on June 9, 2024, leading the National Democratic Alliance (NDA).

questionText: In the March 2024 Russian presidential election, who was re-elected for a fifth presidential term, securing power until at least 2030?
explanation: Vladimir Putin was re-elected President of Russia with over 87% of the vote, extending his presidency until 2030.

questionText: Who made history in June 2024 by being elected as the first female President of Mexico?
explanation: Climate scientist and former Mexico City mayor Claudia Sheinbaum won the presidential election by a landslide, taking office on October 1, 2024.

questionText: Following the resignation of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina in August 2024, who was appointed as the Chief Adviser of Bangladesh's interim government?
explanation: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Dr. Muhammad Yunus assumed office as Chief Adviser to head the interim administration following the student-led uprising.

questionText: Who was elected as the new President of the Islamic Republic of Iran in July 2024 following the tragic death of President Ebrahim Raisi?
explanation: Reformist cardiac surgeon Masoud Pezeshkian won the runoff election and took oath as the 9th President of Iran on July 30, 2024.

questionText: Who assumed office as the Prime Minister of Japan in October 2024, succeeding Fumio Kishida?
explanation: Shigeru Ishiba was elected president of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and confirmed as Prime Minister on October 1, 2024.

questionText: Who was elected as the 8th President of Indonesia in February 2024, succeeding Joko Widodo?
explanation: Former Defense Minister Prabowo Subianto was inaugurated as President of Indonesia on October 20, 2024.

questionText: In July 2024, which political coalition won the most seats in France's snap parliamentary elections called by President Emmanuel Macron?
explanation: The broad left-wing New Popular Front won a plurality of seats in the National Assembly, defying poll predictions.

questionText: Who was appointed as the Prime Minister of France by President Emmanuel Macron in September 2024 to form a government?
explanation: Veteran conservative politician and former EU Brexit negotiator Michel Barnier was appointed Prime Minister of France.

questionText: Who was re-elected as President of the European Commission for a second five-year term in July 2024?
explanation: The European Parliament voted to grant Ursula von der Leyen a second term as President of the European Commission.

questionText: Who was appointed as the new Secretary General of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) in October 2024, succeeding Jens Stoltenberg?

options.A: Mark Rutte (former PM of the Netherlands)

correctAnswerText: Mark Rutte (former PM of the Netherlands)
explanation: Former Dutch Prime Minister Mark Rutte took office as NATO's 14th Secretary General on October 1, 2024.

questionText: In March 2024, which country officially became the 32nd member state of NATO after completing its accession process?
explanation: Sweden deposited its instrument of accession in Washington on March 7, 2024, formally becoming the 32nd member of NATO (following Finland's entry in 2023).

questionText: Which Russian city hosted the 16th BRICS Summit in October 2024, the first summit of the bloc following its major historical expansion?
explanation: The 16th BRICS Summit was held in Kazan, Russia from October 22–24, 2024, under the chairmanship of President Vladimir Putin.

questionText: Which new full members officially participated in the BRICS Kazan Summit 2024 following the bloc's expansion?

options.A: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, and the United Arab Emirates (UAE)

correctAnswerText: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, and the United Arab Emirates (UAE)
explanation: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, and the UAE formally joined BRICS on January 1, 2024, attending the Kazan Summit as full members.

questionText: What was the official overarching theme of the 16th BRICS Summit held in Kazan?

options.A: 'Strengthening Multilateralism for Fair Global Development and Security'

correctAnswerText: 'Strengthening Multilateralism for Fair Global Development and Security'
explanation: The summit concluded with the Kazan Declaration focusing on multipolarity, alternative payment mechanisms, and reforming global governance.

questionText: Where was the 50th G7 Summit hosted in June 2024 under the presidency of Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni?
explanation: The 50th G7 Summit was held at Borgo Egnazia in Apulia, Italy from June 13–15, 2024, featuring Pope Francis as a guest speaker on AI ethics.

questionText: Where was the annual G20 Leaders' Summit held in November 2024 under the presidency of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva?
explanation: Brazil hosted the G20 Summit in Rio de Janeiro on November 18–19, 2024, with the theme 'Building a Just World and a Sustainable Planet'.

questionText: Which permanent regional union participated for the first time as a full permanent member of the G20 at the 2024 Rio Summit?
explanation: The 55-member African Union took its permanent seat at the G20 table, having been admitted at the 2023 New Delhi Summit.

questionText: What flagship global initiative did Brazilian President Lula da Silva officially launch at the G20 Rio Summit in 2024?

options.A: Global Alliance Against Hunger and Poverty

correctAnswerText: Global Alliance Against Hunger and Poverty
explanation: Lula launched the Global Alliance Against Hunger and Poverty with over 80 founding member nations to accelerate eradication of extreme poverty by 2030.

questionText: Which country holds the presidency of the G20 for the year 2025, marking the first time the summit is hosted in Africa?
explanation: South Africa assumed the G20 presidency on December 1, 2024, hosting the G20 Summit in 2025.

questionText: Where was the UN Climate Change Conference (COP29) convened in November 2024?
explanation: COP29 took place in Baku, Azerbaijan from November 11–22, 2024, centered on setting a New Collective Quantified Goal (NCQG) on climate finance.

questionText: Which country is scheduled to host the COP30 UN Climate Conference in 2025 in the Amazon gateway city of Belém?
explanation: Brazil will host COP30 in Belém do Pará in November 2025, emphasizing forest preservation and Amazon biome restoration.

questionText: At the historic COP28 in Dubai (December 2023), nations reached a landmark agreement known as the 'UAE Consensus' which explicitly called for:

options.A: 'Transitioning away from fossil fuels in energy systems, in a just, orderly and equitable manner'
options.B: An immediate worldwide ban on motor vehicles by 2025
options.C: The termination of all wind energy projects
options.D: A flat global carbon tax on low-income countries

correctAnswerText: 'Transitioning away from fossil fuels in energy systems, in a just, orderly and equitable manner'
explanation: The UAE Consensus was the first UN climate treaty to explicitly call on countries to transition away from fossil fuels to achieve net zero by 2050.

questionText: Where did NATO celebrate its 75th Anniversary Summit in July 2024, reaffirming support for Ukraine and collective defense?
explanation: NATO's 75th Anniversary Summit was held in Washington, D.C. from July 9–11, 2024, where the North Atlantic Treaty was originally signed in 1949.

questionText: Which country officially held the Presidency of the Council of the European Union in the second half of 2024 (July–December)?
explanation: Hungary held the rotating EU Council Presidency under the motto 'Make Europe Great Again', succeeded by Poland in January 2025.

questionText: Which country hosted the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in October 2024, the first time held in a Pacific Small Island Developing State?
explanation: CHOGM 2024 was hosted in Apia, Samoa, chaired by Prime Minister Fiamē Naomi Mataʻafa and attended by King Charles III.

questionText: Who was elected as the new Commonwealth Secretary-General at the Samoa CHOGM in October 2024?

options.A: Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey (Foreign Minister of Ghana)

correctAnswerText: Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey (Foreign Minister of Ghana)
explanation: Ghana's Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey was elected to succeed Baroness Patricia Scotland as Commonwealth Secretary-General.

questionText: Where was the 44th and 45th ASEAN Summits held in October 2024 under the theme 'ASEAN: Enhancing Connectivity and Resilience'?
explanation: Laos hosted the ASEAN Summits in Vientiane before handing over the 2025 chairmanship to Malaysia.

questionText: Which country assumed the rotating chairmanship of ASEAN for the year 2025?
explanation: Malaysia took over the chairmanship of ASEAN for 2025 under Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim.

questionText: Which international judicial organ in The Hague issued arrest warrants in March 2023 for Russian President Vladimir Putin concerning the armed conflict in Ukraine?
explanation: The ICC issued arrest warrants for Vladimir Putin and Maria Lvova-Belova regarding the unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children.

questionText: In January 2024, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) issued landmark provisional measures in a genocide case brought against Israel by which country?
explanation: South Africa filed proceedings under the Genocide Convention against Israel regarding the war in Gaza, leading to ICJ binding provisional orders.

questionText: In November 2024, the International Criminal Court (ICC) issued arrest warrants for which Israeli officials over alleged war crimes in Gaza?

options.A: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant

correctAnswerText: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant
explanation: The ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I issued arrest warrants for Benjamin Netanyahu and Yoav Gallant, as well as Hamas commander Mohammed Deif.

questionText: Who serves as the President of the World Bank Group, having taken office in June 2023?
explanation: Indian-American business executive Ajay Banga was confirmed as the 14th President of the World Bank.

questionText: Who was re-appointed as Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) for a second five-year term starting in October 2024?
explanation: Bulgarian economist Kristalina Georgieva was unanimously selected by the IMF Executive Board for a second term.

questionText: Who serves as the Director-General of the World Trade Organization (WTO), the first woman and first African to lead the institution?
explanation: Dr. Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala has served as WTO Director-General since March 2021.

questionText: In September 2024, the US Federal Reserve initiated its first interest rate cut in over four years, lowering the federal funds rate by how much?
explanation: Fed Chair Jerome Powell announced a super-sized 50 bps reduction, bringing the benchmark rate to 4.75%–5.00% to support labor market resilience.

questionText: Who serves as the Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US Fed)?
explanation: Jerome Powell has served as the Chairman of the US Federal Reserve since 2018.

questionText: Who serves as the President of the European Central Bank (ECB)?
explanation: Former IMF chief Christine Lagarde serves as the President of the ECB, guiding European monetary policy.

questionText: Which nation officially surpassed Japan in nominal Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in 2024 to become the world's third-largest economy behind the US and China?
explanation: Official economic data confirmed that Germany overtook Japan in dollar-denominated GDP in 2024 due to yen depreciation.

questionText: According to IMF projections, which nation is projected to surpass Germany and Japan to become the world's third-largest economy by 2027?
explanation: With rapid 7%+ annual growth, India is forecast to become the 3rd largest global economy by 2027.

questionText: In 2024, which cryptocurrency exchange co-founder was sentenced to 25 years in federal prison for defrauding billions from customers of the collapsed FTX exchange?
explanation: FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in US prison in March 2024 for massive wire fraud and conspiracy.

questionText: In January 2024, the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) approved the first regulated spot exchange-traded funds (ETFs) for which digital asset?
explanation: The SEC approved 11 spot Bitcoin ETFs in January 2024, triggering institutional capital inflows and new record highs above $90,000 in late 2024.

questionText: Which microchip designer became the most valuable publicly traded company in the world in mid-2024, surpassing $3 trillion market cap driven by AI chip demand?
explanation: NVIDIA, led by CEO Jensen Huang, surged past Apple and Microsoft to become the world's most valuable firm due to soaring demand for H100/Blackwell AI GPUs.

questionText: What is the name of the comprehensive legislation enacted by the European Union in 2024 as the world's first comprehensive legal framework regulating Artificial Intelligence?

options.A: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act)

correctAnswerText: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act)
explanation: The EU AI Act entered into force in August 2024, categorizing AI applications into risk tiers with strict rules for high-risk and general-purpose AI.

questionText: In 2024, which Latin American country adopted the US Dollar while drastically cutting public spending under libertarian President Javier Milei?
explanation: President Javier Milei introduced radical fiscal austerity ('chainsaw policy') to eradicate monthly budget deficits and combat triple-digit inflation.

questionText: Which country launched the world's largest emissions trading scheme (ETS) covering carbon emissions from power and industrial sectors?
explanation: China's national carbon ETS covers over 5 billion metric tons of CO2 annually, making it the largest carbon market by volume.

questionText: What is the name of the new digital payment messaging system piloted by BRICS countries in 2024 to facilitate local currency trade outside SWIFT?
explanation: BRICS Pay was presented at the 2024 Kazan business forum as a decentralized digital settlement initiative to reduce US dollar dependence.

questionText: Who was appointed as the 14th Secretary-General of the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), rebranded as UN Trade & Development?
explanation: Costa Rican economist Rebeca Grynspan leads UN Trade & Development, championing developing country trade rights.

questionText: Which nation in Africa completed the construction of the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD) on the Blue Nile, generating dispute with downstream Egypt and Sudan?
explanation: Ethiopia finalized the 5,150 MW GERD reservoir filling, sparking diplomatic friction over Nile water rights.

questionText: Which Caribbean island nation faced a total state and constitutional collapse in early 2024, leading to the deployment of a UN-authorized Kenyan police security mission?
explanation: Following gang takeovers in Port-au-Prince, Prime Minister Ariel Henry resigned and a Multinational Security Support Mission led by Kenya was deployed.

questionText: The Panama Canal experienced severe transit restrictions in 2023–2024 due to:

options.A: Severe climate-induced drought depleting Gatun Lake water levels

correctAnswerText: Severe climate-induced drought depleting Gatun Lake water levels
explanation: El Niño and drought caused water shortages in the Panama Canal freshwater lock system, slashing daily ship transits from 36 to under 24.

questionText: The Suez Canal and Red Sea maritime shipping suffered major global disruptions throughout 2024 due to drone and missile attacks launched by:
explanation: Yemen's Houthi forces targeted commercial shipping vessels in the Bab-el-Mandeb strait, forcing global container ships to reroute around Africa's Cape of Good Hope.

questionText: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to John J. Hopfield and Geoffrey E. Hinton for:

options.A: Foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks
options.C: The development of blue light-emitting diodes
options.D: Theoretical discoveries of topological phase transitions

correctAnswerText: Foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks
explanation: Pioneering computer scientists John Hopfield (Hopfield network) and Geoffrey Hinton (Boltzmann machine/deep learning) won the 2024 Physics Nobel.

questionText: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was divided, with one half to David Baker for computational protein design, and the other half jointly to which two scientists for protein structure prediction?

options.A: Demis Hassabis and John M. Jumper (Google DeepMind)
options.C: K. Barry Sharpless and Carolyn Bertozzi

correctAnswerText: Demis Hassabis and John M. Jumper (Google DeepMind)
explanation: Demis Hassabis and John Jumper were awarded the Chemistry Nobel for developing AlphaFold, solving a 50-year-old biological grand challenge.

questionText: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun for:

options.A: The discovery of microRNA and its fundamental role in post-transcriptional gene regulation
options.B: The development of mRNA COVID-19 vaccines
options.D: Discoveries of molecular mechanisms controlling circadian rhythm

correctAnswerText: The discovery of microRNA and its fundamental role in post-transcriptional gene regulation
explanation: American biologists Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun discovered microRNAs—tiny RNA molecules that control gene expression in multicellular organisms.

questionText: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded to which author, becoming the first South Korean writer to win the prestigious award?
explanation: South Korean novelist Han Kang (author of 'The Vegetarian') won the 2024 Literature Nobel 'for her intense poetic prose that confronts historical traumas and exposes the fragility of human life'.

questionText: The 2024 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to which organization 'for its efforts to achieve a world free of nuclear weapons'?

options.A: Nihon Hidankyo (Japanese confederation of atomic bomb survivors)
options.D: International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons (ICAN)

correctAnswerText: Nihon Hidankyo (Japanese confederation of atomic bomb survivors)
explanation: Nihon Hidankyo, the grassroots movement of Hibakusha (survivors of Hiroshima and Nagasaki), won the Peace Prize for demonstrating through witness testimony that nuclear weapons must never be used again.

questionText: The 2024 Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel was awarded to Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson, and James A. Robinson for:

options.A: Studies of how societal institutions are formed and affect long-term national prosperity
options.C: Research on banks and financial crises

correctAnswerText: Studies of how societal institutions are formed and affect long-term national prosperity
explanation: The economists (authors of 'Why Nations Fail') demonstrated that inclusive political and economic institutions foster prosperity, whereas extractive institutions lead to persistent poverty.

questionText: In October 2024, NASA launched which flagship robotic spacecraft to investigate whether Jupiter's icy moon has conditions suitable for life?
explanation: NASA's Europa Clipper launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy to conduct flybys of Jupiter's moon Europa, examining its vast subsurface saltwater ocean.

questionText: In June 2024, China's space program achieved a world-first scientific feat by returning the first-ever rock and soil samples from the lunar far side via which spacecraft?
explanation: Chang'e 6 safely returned 1,935 grams of lunar material from the South Pole–Aitken Basin on the never-before-sampled far side of the Moon.

questionText: In October 2024, SpaceX achieved a breakthrough in aerospace engineering during Starship Flight 5 by:

options.A: Catching the returning Super Heavy rocket booster out of mid-air using mechanical 'chopstick' arms on the launch tower
options.C: Deploying 1,000 satellites in a single launch

correctAnswerText: Catching the returning Super Heavy rocket booster out of mid-air using mechanical 'chopstick' arms on the launch tower
explanation: SpaceX's Starbase launch tower in Boca Chica, Texas caught the 232-foot-tall Super Heavy booster in mid-air using mechanical arms ('Mechazilla'), ushering in full rocket reusability.

questionText: In September 2024, the Polaris Dawn private space mission achieved the world's first-ever commercial civilian spacewalk (EVA) led by billionaire astronaut:
explanation: Jared Isaacman and SpaceX engineer Sarah Gillis conducted the first commercial extravehicular activity (EVA) at an altitude of 737 kilometers.

questionText: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) in 2024 discovered the most distant and earliest known galaxy ever observed, existing just 290 million years after the Big Bang, designated:
explanation: Astronomers using JWST confirmed JADES-GS-z14-0 with a redshift of z = 14.32, rewriting understanding of early cosmic structure.

questionText: In 2024, which international particle physics laboratory in Geneva celebrated its 70th anniversary since foundation in 1954?
explanation: CERN, home to the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), marked 70 years of pioneering fundamental physics discoveries.

questionText: In 2024, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared which infectious viral outbreak in Central and West Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)?
explanation: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared the surge of the virulent Mpox Clade Ib variant in DR Congo and neighboring countries a global health emergency in August 2024.

questionText: Who serves as the Director-General of the World Health Organization (WHO)?
explanation: Ethiopian public health leader Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus serves as WHO Director-General.

questionText: What is the name of the premier international agreement finalized by the UN in 2023–2024 to conserve marine biodiversity in ocean waters beyond national jurisdiction?
explanation: The High Seas Treaty creates the first legal framework to establish marine protected areas in international ocean waters.

questionText: In 2024, the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) announced that green sea turtles and Iberian lynx populations had recovered due to:

options.A: Targeted global conservation and protected habitat legislation

correctAnswerText: Targeted global conservation and protected habitat legislation
explanation: The Iberian lynx was downlisted from 'Endangered' to 'Vulnerable', demonstrating the triumph of concerted habitat conservation.

questionText: Which tech giant released the Gemini multimodal generative AI models in 2023–2024, integrating native vision, text, audio, and code reasoning?
explanation: Google introduced Gemini, its most advanced multimodal AI models engineered natively for cross-modal reasoning.

questionText: Which nation launched the world's first satellite-based quantum communication network and initiated quantum computing supremacy experiments named Jiuzhang?
explanation: China has developed world-leading quantum key distribution (QKD) satellite networks through the Micius quantum satellite.

questionText: What is the name of the revolutionary anti-obesity and diabetes GLP-1 receptor agonist drugs developed by Novo Nordisk that surged in global demand in 2023–2024?
explanation: Semaglutide transformed cardiovascular and obesity medicine, propelling Danish drugmaker Novo Nordisk to Europe's most valuable company.

questionText: In 2024, which private space company completed the first private commercial lunar lander to land on the Moon under NASA's CLPS program, named Odysseus?
explanation: Intuitive Machines' Nova-C lander 'Odysseus' landed near the Moon's south pole in February 2024, marking the first US lunar touchdown in over 50 years.

questionText: Which city hosted the Games of the XXXIII Olympiad (2024 Summer Olympics) from July 26 to August 11, 2024?
explanation: Paris hosted the 2024 Olympic Games, featuring a unique opening ceremony along the River Seine.

questionText: Which country topped the official medal tally at the 2024 Paris Olympic Games with 40 Gold medals and 126 total medals?
explanation: The United States won 40 gold, 44 silver, and 42 bronze (126 total) to top the medal table ahead of China (40 gold, 91 total).

questionText: Which urban sport made its official Olympic debut at the 2024 Paris Games?
explanation: Breaking was introduced as an official medal sport for the first time at the Place de la Concorde in Paris.

questionText: Which nation will host the next Summer Olympic Games in 2028?
explanation: Los Angeles will host the 2028 Summer Olympic Games (LA28), followed by Brisbane in 2032.

questionText: Which country won the UEFA Euro 2024 football championship in Germany, defeating England 2-1 in the final in Berlin?
explanation: Spain won their record-breaking 4th UEFA European Championship on July 14, 2024, having won all seven matches in the tournament.

questionText: Which 17-year-old Spanish football sensation won the Young Player of the Tournament award at UEFA Euro 2024?
explanation: Barcelona prodigy Lamine Yamal became the youngest scorer and champion in European Championship history.

questionText: Which country won the 2024 Copa América tournament held in the United States, defeating Colombia 1-0 in extra time?
explanation: Argentina, captained by Lionel Messi, won a record 16th Copa América title at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami.

questionText: Which country won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024, defeating South Africa in a thrilling final in Barbados?
explanation: India, captained by Rohit Sharma, defeated South Africa by 7 runs in Bridgetown, Barbados to claim their second T20 World Cup title.

questionText: Which two nations co-hosted the ICC Men's T20 World Cup in June 2024, bringing elite cricket to the USA for the first time?

options.A: United States and the West Indies

correctAnswerText: United States and the West Indies
explanation: The 2024 T20 World Cup was co-hosted across venues in the United States (New York, Texas, Florida) and six Caribbean nations.

questionText: Who was awarded the prestigious Men's Ballon d'Or 2024 as the world's best football player in Paris in October 2024?

options.A: Rodri (Rodrigo Hernández Cascante - Manchester City / Spain)

correctAnswerText: Rodri (Rodrigo Hernández Cascante - Manchester City / Spain)
explanation: Spanish defensive midfielder Rodri won the 2024 Ballon d'Or after winning the Premier League with Manchester City and Euro 2024 with Spain.

questionText: Who won the Women's Ballon d'Or (Ballon d'Or Féminin) for the second consecutive year in 2024?
explanation: Spanish midfielder Aitana Bonmatí retained her title as the world's best female footballer following a historic quadruple with FC Barcelona.

questionText: In tennis, who won the Men's Singles title at both the 2024 Australian Open and US Open, finishing the year as world No. 1?
explanation: Italy's Jannik Sinner enjoyed a dominant season, capturing two Grand Slam titles and the ATP Finals crown.

questionText: Which tennis star won the French Open (Roland Garros) and Wimbledon Men's Singles titles in the summer of 2024?
explanation: Spanish star Carlos Alcaraz completed the rare Channel Slam by winning the French Open and Wimbledon back-to-back.

questionText: Which tennis legend completed the career 'Golden Slam' by winning the Men's Singles Gold Medal at the Paris 2024 Olympics?
explanation: Novak Djokovic defeated Carlos Alcaraz in the Olympic final to win the Olympic gold medal, cementing his legacy with all four Grand Slams and Olympic Gold.

questionText: Which country is scheduled to host the 2030 FIFA World Cup across three continents (Spain, Portugal, Morocco, with opening matches in Argentina, Paraguay, Uruguay)?

options.A: Spain, Portugal, and Morocco (centenary matches in South America)

correctAnswerText: Spain, Portugal, and Morocco (centenary matches in South America)
explanation: FIFA confirmed the joint bid of Spain, Portugal, and Morocco as the sole candidate for World Cup 2030, celebrating the centenary in South America.

questionText: Which nation was confirmed by FIFA as the sole bidder and official host of the 2034 FIFA World Cup?
explanation: Saudi Arabia was confirmed by FIFA as the host of the 2034 Men's FIFA World Cup.

questionText: In October 2024, which two nuclear-armed Asian powers reached a major border agreement to disengage troops and resume military patrolling along the Line of Actual Control (LAC)?
explanation: China and India finalized an agreement ending a four-year military standoff in eastern Ladakh, leading to a bilateral meeting between Xi Jinping and Narendra Modi at the BRICS Kazan Summit.

questionText: Who was sworn in as the 47th President of Sri Lanka in September 2024, leading the leftist National People's Power (NPP) coalition?
explanation: Marxist-leaning political leader Anura Kumara Dissanayake won Sri Lanka's presidential election on anti-corruption and IMF debt renegotiation promises.

questionText: In November 2024, which nation in East Asia held snap parliamentary elections where the ruling coalition of Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba lost its parliamentary majority?
explanation: Japan's ruling LDP-Komeito coalition lost its lower house majority in October 2024, necessitating cross-party negotiations.

questionText: Which South American nation experienced deep political turmoil in July 2024 following disputed presidential election results where both Nicolás Maduro and opposition candidate Edmundo González claimed victory?
explanation: Venezuela's National Electoral Council declared Nicolás Maduro re-elected, sparking international criticism and contested voter tallies.

questionText: The treaty establishing the European Union's border-free travel zone is named after which village where it was signed in 1985?
explanation: The Schengen Agreement eliminated internal border checks across 29 European countries, with Romania and Bulgaria joining air/sea zones in 2024.

questionText: Which Southeast Asian nation officially submitted its letter of intent to join the OECD (Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development) and applied for BRICS in 2024?
explanation: Thailand formally applied for BRICS membership and initiated accession talks with the OECD to enhance its global economic integration.

questionText: In 2024, the United Nations General Assembly adopted a landmark resolution endorsing the advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) demanding an end to:

options.A: The unlawful Israeli occupation of the Palestinian territories within 12 months
options.C: The use of fossil fuels globally by 2026
options.D: The veto power in the UN Security Council immediately

correctAnswerText: The unlawful Israeli occupation of the Palestinian territories within 12 months
explanation: The UN General Assembly passed a resolution by 124 votes demanding that Israel bring an end without delay to its unlawful presence in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

questionText: Who is the current President of the 79th Session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), who assumed office in September 2024?
explanation: Former Prime Minister of Cameroon Philemon Yang was elected President of the 79th Session of the UNGA.

questionText: What is the central theme of the United Nations 'Pact for the Future' adopted by world leaders at the Summit of the Future in New York in September 2024?

options.A: Reinvigorating multilateralism, reforming the UN Security Council and international financial architecture, and safeguarding future generations
options.C: Banning all fossil fuel extraction within 2 years

correctAnswerText: Reinvigorating multilateralism, reforming the UN Security Council and international financial architecture, and safeguarding future generations
explanation: World leaders adopted the landmark 'Pact for the Future' and the Global Digital Compact to modernize international governance, address AI governance, and protect coming generations.
